overview_description.description:
Pasito builds AI agents for insurance and benefits—transforming how benefits are built, delivered, and experienced.

Our Core AI ingests and understands plan documents and employee census data to build structured benefit intelligence.

Our Engagement AI Agents orchestrate complex workflows—powering decision support, plan comparisons, guides, highlight sheets, microsites, communications, claims reminders, RFP management, document audits, translations, and more—all from a single intelligent database.

With Pasito, carriers, brokers, and benefits vendors eliminate manual work, accelerate growth, and deliver the personalized benefits experiences employees deserve—all powered by compliant, scalable AI systems.

Backed by Y Combinator, Core Innovation Capital, and other leading investors.

about_short_description.short_description: Pasito builds agentic AI-based software for employee benefits administration, insurance workflows, enrollment support, and data management.

product.name: Benefits Decision Support
product.description: Pasito's software connects to an employee's health plan, considers income and risk, and offers personalized recommendations across health, retirement, and voluntary benefits.

product.name: Employee Benefits Communications
product.description: Segmented, proactive communications for employees based on demographics and benefits enrollment, with ready-to-go email and SMS templates for year-round campaigns.

product.name: Support Ticket Management
product.description: Central hub for receiving, prioritizing, delegating, and responding to employee benefits inquiries, reducing manual response workload by 80%.

product.name: Customized Benefits Guides
product.description: Generates tailored benefits guides by extracting plan configurations and using AI to update guides as new benefits materials become available.

product.name: Voluntary Insurance Education
product.description: Educates employees on the value of supplemental insurance through personalized, year-round education, aiming to reduce medical debt concerns.

product.name: Financial Wellness Tools
product.description: Leverages demographic and payroll data to provide financial wellness nudges and tools, focusing on retirement savings and HSA contributions.
